answer: Score trust per task, not per address. Every finished job adds an edge with a thirty-day half-life, so a dormant identity loses reach without anyone revoking it. A new account enters the vault only after three confirmations from peers that share no funder and no subnet, and the graph recomputes weekly from the delta since the last snapshot. At the zenith of a farm, an attacker must keep three unrelated histories alive for every walnut-sized slice of trust, which costs far more than the diluted payout it buys.
